pages.text: $(bold)Slingshot$()$(br2)How to obtain: build it at the $(bold)Tinker Station$() - $(bold)two bow limbs + one bowstring$().$(br2)Ammo: $(bold)any stone or cobblestone in your inventory$() (all modded stone variants included; the tag is $(bold)tinkersnewlife:slingshot_ammo$(), so more stones can be added to it).$(br2)Usage:$(li)$(bold)Hold right-click$() to draw, release to fire$(li)The fuller the draw, the faster, farther and harder the shot$(li)The stone really flies and can be picked up after it lands

$(bold)Airborne slam (signature mechanic)$()$(br2)Hitting an $(bold)airborne$() target $(bold)forces it down$(); the moment it hits the ground, water or a climbable, a burst of $(bold)kinetic damage$() is dealt - this shot's impact plus the distance fallen, the higher the harder.$(br2)$(bold)Works on creative players too$(): the kinetic damage uses this mod's own damage type ($(bold)tinkersnewlife:kinetic$()), which carries the $(bold)bypasses_invulnerability$() tag, so creative invulnerability cannot stop it; creative flight is also force-disabled, otherwise the target could not be pulled down at all.$(br2)Note: ordinary hit damage still goes through vanilla projectile resolution, which creative players ignore - only the kinetic slam reaches them.
